name: Christmas Night Shift Coloring Book for Nurses
seoTitle: Christmas Night Shift Nurse Coloring Book
metaDescription: A Christmas coloring book with 40 night shift scenes made for nurses. A stocking stuffer for a nurse working the holidays or unwinding after nights.
summary: Forty night shift scenes with a holiday twist, a playful stocking stuffer for the nurse who is working Christmas while everyone else sleeps.
whyItWorks: Somebody has to be on the unit at 3 a.m. on Christmas, and the nurses who take those shifts rarely get a gift that acknowledges it. A coloring book built around night shift scenes does exactly that, with a wink. It says you know what their holiday really looks like, from the quiet hallways to the snacks at the station.

Coloring is also a genuinely easy way to come down after nights, when the body is tired but the brain is still running. It asks nothing, takes no screen time, and can be picked up for ten minutes before sleep. The book format makes it a light, budget friendly gift for a Secret Santa exchange or a stocking. Add a pack of colored pencils or fine markers so it is ready to use the moment it is unwrapped, and consider writing a short note on the first page.
goodToKnow: Coloring tools are not mentioned in the title, so plan on buying pencils or markers separately.
Check the listing for the page format and whether the scenes are printed on one side, which matters for markers.
The night shift theme lands best with nurses who actually work nights or holidays.

faq.q: Is this a good gift for a nurse working Christmas?
faq.a: Yes, that is exactly who it is for. It acknowledges the holiday shift with humor and gives them something calm to do afterward.

faq.q: Does it work as a Secret Santa gift?
faq.a: It fits well, since it is small, inexpensive, and themed enough to feel thoughtful without being personal.
